⚡ Renewables can do more than generate clean power. Combined with modern grids, storage and digital intelligence, they can deliver reliable energy for people.
 
In 2025, the world added a record 692 GW of renewable power capacity, alongside 108 GW of new battery storage, 40% more than the year before.  
 
Together, these investments create a major opportunity. Grids can move electricity where it is needed, storage can make it available beyond the hours when the sun shines or the wind blows, and digital tools can help systems respond to changing supply and demand.
 
For people, that means health facilities that keep operating, schools that stay connected, businesses that can grow and communities that are better prepared for disruption.
 
Uruguay shows what coordinated investment can achieve. Through long-term policy, public investment and power-system planning, the country reached a 98% share of renewables in its electricity mix in 2019.
 
For me, this is how energy progress should be measured: not only by how much clean power a system can produce, but by how reliably it improves people’s lives.
 
For close to 1 billion people served by health facilities with unreliable electricity or none at all, reliability determines whether vaccines stay cold, medical equipment works and essential care continues.  
 
Three investments can unlock this opportunity:
 
🌍 Modern and decentralized grids bring clean energy closer to people, connecting generation, storage and demand while helping essential services withstand disruptions.
 
🔋 Storage makes variable power dependable, capturing electricity when supply is abundant and releasing it when demand rises.
 
📊 Digital management adds flexibility. Better forecasting and digitally enabled demand response could reduce renewable curtailment by more than 25% by 2030.
 
Across the Global South, this is an opportunity to build renewable capacity and the infrastructure that makes it reliable at the same time.
 
Renewable capacity shows what we can generate. Integrated energy systems show what we can deliver.
